dedupe_keys.name: china provincial crop area affected by disasters 1978 2022 earth resource data cloud

description: A provincial panel of crop areas hit by natural disasters in China. The dataset page (published 26 January 2026) says it gives the total crop area affected by disasters, in thousand hectares, for the 31 mainland provincial units from 1978 to 2022, covering floods, droughts, wind and hail, frost and other hazards, compiled without modification from Ministry of Emergency Management (affected area) and Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs (damaged area) figures. The portal lists it as a free resource for download. Coverage is mainland China by province. Caveats: the page notes missing data in recent years, and it is a compilation of official tables, not a new survey. For simulation it gives a 45-year record of disaster impacts on farmland, to calibrate provincial crop loss models. A related catalogue record is the ADIA agricultural drought impact dataset for China.
